senses.gloss:
पू {c1c} {c4c} A., {c9c} U. (पवते, पूयते,
पुनाति, पुनीते, पूत; caus. पावयति; desid.
पुपूषति, पिपविषते)
1 To make pure,
cleanse, purify (lit. and fig.);
अवश्यपाव्यं पवसे Bk. 6. 64; 3. 18;
पुण्याश्रमदर्शनेन तावदात्मानं पुनीमहे
Ś. 1; Ms. 1. 105; 2. 62; Y. 1. 58;
R. 1. 53; Bg. 10. 31.
--2 To refine.
--3 To clean from chaff, winnow.
--4
To expiate, atone for.
--5 To
discern, discriminate.
--6 To think out,
devise, invent.
--7 To become clear
or pure (Atm.).

पू a. (At the end of comp.)
Purifying, cleansing, refining; as in
खलपू &c.
